result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\. Both are excellent business password managers, but they suit slightly different priorities.

My overall recommendation is **1Password for ease of use and Bitwarden for value**\.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

Best for teams that want an easy-to-use, polished solution.

- Shared vaults for departments and projects
- Granular access permissions
- Easy employee onboarding and offboarding
- Security alerts and password health monitoring

**Price\:** Around \$24.95/month for up to 10 users with Teams Starter Pack (USD).

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Test Bitwarden Premium - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hC5M3yQmIFKAAlHcnKpChWSt35-xr8mlIVRywSu-o8DpkerDwLMFxvrII2QFuvOsSP0k6Fo_mQuwr7t8sXrBNPDXf_LEbep8cD4z2PlCIIwWjH4OqBMrEZ0-9cp7BChiCyWOBI7Pq7evrJY8TBbAUMof-Y5H7s49GfDyBJKLiGrh0gHLhDv6TMbIv6ti_DVz?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

Best for budget-conscious teams that still want strong security.

- Open-source software
- Shared collections
- Admin console and audit logs
- Good cross-platform support

**Price\:** Around \$4/user/month for Teams (USD, annual billing).

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**
Best for businesses wanting more administrative control.

- Shared team folders
- Role-based access
- Detailed security policies
- Additional security and compliance options

**Price\:** Entry plans start around \$2/user/month (USD, annual billing).

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**
Best for privacy-focused businesses.

- End-to-end encrypted vaults
- Secure credential sharing
- Email aliases
- Privacy-focused ecosystem

**Price\:** Business plans start around \$1.99/user/month (USD).

[Proton Pass business plans](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Pricing is approximate and depends on billing term, region and plan. Sources: [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Shared passwords | Yes | Yes |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Security | Excellent | Excellent |
| Budget friendly | Good | Excellent |
| Best for | Simplicity | Value |


## What I'd choose

For a small business with 5–20 employees, I'd lean toward 1Password.

The biggest advantage isn't just storing passwords. It's being able to\:

- Give employees access only to the passwords they need.
- Share company logins without sending passwords through email or Slack.
- Remove someone's access immediately when they leave.
- Keep personal and company passwords separate.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I'd like to make a recommendation based on how your team actually works.

**1\. How many people need access?**

---

**2\. What's your approximate monthly budget?**

---

**3\. What will you primarily use it for?**

---

**4\. What does your company use?**
